intro: How File Explorer looks and behaves: what it opens to, which files and folders it shows, what the navigation pane holds, and extra commands on the right-click menu. Desktop icons are here too.

groups.Context Menu: The right-click menu. Switch to the full Windows 10-style menu, show or hide Open in Windows Terminal and Ask Copilot, and add commands such as Take Ownership, SFC /SCANNOW, Repair Windows Image, CHKDSK and Compress To.
groups.Devices and Peripherals: Dynamic Lighting for RGB devices, whether Windows picks your default printer for you, and AutoPlay for USB drives, discs and memory cards.
groups.General: What File Explorer opens to, whether folders open in the same window, single or double click, and what Quick Access shows.
groups.Files and Folders: How files and folders are shown: file extensions, hidden and system files, thumbnails and the icon cache, the status bar, check boxes, and support for paths longer than 260 characters.
groups.Navigation Pane: What the left pane of File Explorer shows: Home, Gallery, Libraries, your user folders, and removable drives.
groups.File Associations: Bring back Windows Photo Viewer and legacy Notepad as the apps that open images and text files.
groups.Desktop: Which system icons appear on the desktop, the arrow on shortcut icons, and the "- Shortcut" text Windows adds to new shortcut names.
groups.This PC Folders: Which of your folders, such as Desktop, Documents and Downloads, appear under This PC.
groups.Network: Shows the classic "Users must enter a user name and password to use this computer" check box in User Accounts.
